label: Camdenboss CTB0158-10
description:
Camdenboss CTB0158-10

5.08mm (0.2") Pitch Standard Profile 90 ̊ Rising Clamp Terminal, 10 pole


The real-life connectors are modular, made up of two or three connector blocks slotted together. These can be further slotted together to make larger connectors.


Fritzing part is derived from Screw terminals by Lionel Michel.


Because of the offset between connection pins and screw terminals, these are implemented male / female pairs of connectors with an internal connection.
